problems.title: Mess Token Pair
problems.statement:
The hostel mess sells meal tokens of different values. Given the values of n tokens in the order they were bought and a target amount T, find two different tokens whose values add up to exactly T.

Print their 1-based positions i and j (i < j). If several pairs work, print the pair with the smallest j; among those, the smallest i. If no pair exists, print -1.
problems.input_format:
Line 1: n and T.
Line 2: n integers, the token values.
problems.expected: O(n) time with a hash map

problems.title: Attendance Streak
problems.statement:
Your attendance for n working days is a string of P (present) and A (absent). The department will condone at most k absences with a medical certificate.

Find the length of the longest run of consecutive days that contains at most k absences.
problems.input_format:
Line 1: n and k.
Line 2: the attendance string of length n.

problems.title: Merge Canteen Bookings
problems.statement:
Clubs book the canteen hall for time slots [start, end]. Two bookings that overlap or touch (one starts at or before the other ends) are merged into one block.

Print the merged blocks in order of start time.
problems.input_format:
Line 1: n.
Next n lines: start end.
problems.output_format:
Line 1: number of merged blocks.
Then one line per block: start end.
problems.expected: O(n log n) sort then sweep

problems.title: Top Skills on the Notice Board
problems.statement: The placement cell collected the skill tags from every job posting this season. Print the k most frequent tags with their counts. Break ties by the tag in alphabetical order.
problems.input_format:
Line 1: n and k.
Line 2: n lowercase tags separated by spaces.
problems.output_format: Up to k lines: tag count.
problems.expected: O(n + u log u) with a counter

problems.title: Exam Paper Evaluation
problems.statement:
n answer-script bundles must be evaluated in the given order. Each of m evaluators takes a contiguous run of bundles (at least one each). Bundle i has p_i pages.

Split the bundles so the largest number of pages any single evaluator reads is as small as possible, and print that number.
problems.input_format:
Line 1: n and m.
Line 2: n integers p_i.
problems.expected: O(n log(sum)) binary search on the answer

problems.title: Campus Shuttle
problems.statement: The campus has n shuttle stops joined by m two-way roads. Find the minimum number of roads to travel from stop s to stop d, or -1 if d cannot be reached.
problems.input_format:
Line 1: n and m.
Next m lines: u v (a road).
Last line: s d.

problems.title: Anagram Club Names
problems.statement: Students proposed n names for new clubs. Names that are anagrams of each other count as the same idea. Print how many distinct ideas there are and the size of the largest group.
problems.input_format:
Line 1: n.
Line 2: n lowercase words.
problems.output_format: Two integers: groups and largest group size.
problems.expected: O(n · L log L) by sorting letters

Next r lines: c integers each.
